Name: Mergable Machines
Author: rsjww
Description:
[size=3][b]Tired of filling your entire farm with rows of identical machines?
[/b]
This simple mod lets you combine identical machines into a single tile, allowing you to stack them together and manage them as one. Merged machines work using a simple multiplier system. A stacked machine will receive inputs and produce outputs as if multiple machines were running at the same time. For example, a stack of 5 furnaces will smelt 25 ores at once, and a stack of 10 kegs will produce 10 drinks simultaneously.

This mod works well with my previous mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42853]Balanced Automate[/url]﻿. (One of my mod to simplify Automate!) Using both mods allows you to build efficient automated production setups while keeping your farm clean.

And, sure thing, this mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]﻿, so you can still use this with Automate!

You may check more compatibility notes in the setion below!

Demo: (With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42853]Balanced Automate[/url]﻿, where the ouput items are allowed to auto stack)

[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]. Android users should also install the [url=https://github.com/NRTnarathip/SMAPILoader/releases]SMAPI Loader[/url].[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xEV4WhO.png[/img]

Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], or change in config.json after first-run.
You can configure:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][size=3]Max Merge Size: The maximum machines allowed to merge, default 99. (Note! The max stack size in SDV is 999, which means a single machine can’t simply output more than 999 product at once. )[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]Merge Digit Opacity: The opacity of digit.[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]which machines to enable this mod.[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]The Key binds of Quick Stack! See "How to use" Section for details.[/size][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/j6fpZ3A.png[/img]

To merge machines, right-click a tile that already has a machine.[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Hold [b]Shift[/b] to merge 5 machines at once.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Hold [b]Ctrl + Shift[/b] to merge 25 machines at once.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]You can configure your own keybinds in GMCM.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]
By default, you can hold [b]Q [/b]to force-stack machines such as Tapper, Bee House, and more! Check GMCM for more details!
Note: You won’t get multiple batteries from stacked Lightning Rods, so it’s best to avoid stacking them.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]

Credits:
This mod was partly inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7411]Combine Machines[/url], which is a fantastic mod! While both mods share the idea of merging machines, this mod focuses on a simpler and more lightweight approach, where machines simply scale their input and output based on the stack size. The digit display method used to show machine stack counts is also inspired by Combine Machines.
